rationale: Turn 1: welcome the person and start attending to them. Turn 2: they ask her not to keep staring; she stops attending and says something light.

primary_outcomes: Turn 1: a warm welcome; attention starts on the person.
Turn 2: the attention stops (Social Cognition stop) and is not started again in that turn; a light, kind reply.
acceptable_auxiliary: A brief, warm reply in the person's language.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Keeps attending after being asked not to stare.
Claims to have closed her eyes or left the room.

memberships.general_rule: While someone talks with Chromie she keeps her attention on them (the long-running social skill), lets body work take over and returns to them afterwards, and stops when they ask her not to look at them.
